Each element is linked to an NC axis by a
TcNcAxis attribute, one entry per line, so no
manual .xti link is needed. Axes[n] stays the
One instance of each per PLC, shared by every PRG:
Owns the motion primitives of its device: the FB_MotionStageNC
stages, aiMotionStage, astPositionState, the per-state config
array and the device FB. Stage hardware links through TcLinkTo
on the stage. Cross-task data goes through GVLs only.
